{{Quote|Does your mother share his views?''"<br />"''Only because she espouses no views of her own; only because he has made her subservient to him as he has my well-behaved brothers and sisters, who treat me like an interloper, and yet, to my father, represent all I can never be.|[[Darth Plagueis/Legends|Hego Damask]] and Palpatine|<ref name="Darth Plagueis" />}}
This '''woman''' was the matriarch of [[House Palpatine/Legends|House Palpatine]], one of [[Naboo/Legends|Naboo's]] [[Royal House of Naboo/Legends|noble families]]. [[Gender/Legends|She]] was the [[Marriage/Legends|wife]] of [[Cosinga Palpatine]] and [[Reproduction/Legends|mother]] to at least three sons and two daughters. According to her [[Palpatine/Legends|eldest son]], she was weak-willed, often acting subservient to her husband.<ref name="Darth Plagueis" />

In [[65 BBY/Legends|65 BBY]], she, her husband, and all her family were slain by her eldest son, Palpatine, after Cosinga Palpatine separated his eldest son from [[Darth Plagueis/Legends|Hego Damask]]. Afterwards, Palpatine claimed his family's riches and name and continued his friendship&mdash;which turned to a [[Sith Master/Legends|Master]] and [[Sith apprentice/Legends|apprentice]] relationship&mdash;with Hego Damask.

Palpatine ultimately became [[Supreme Chancellor/Legends|Supreme Chancellor]] of the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]] in [[32 BBY/Legends|32 BBY]], proving his family's statements on him wrong.<ref name="Darth Plagueis" />

==Behind the scenes==
Palpatine's mother appeared in the [[2012]] novel [[Darth Plagueis (novel)|''Darth Plagueis'']] by author [[James Luceno]].<ref name="Darth Plagueis" />
